name: honeybadger
description: Set up Honeybadger, debug errors, investigate incidents from logs, create alarms, and monitor cron jobs, with live account access via the Honeybadger MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to your Honeybadger account. Triage and debug production errors, investigate incidents by querying your logs and events, create alarms, and monitor cron jobs and scheduled tasks with check-ins. Includes skills for adding Honeybadger to an app and the Honeybadger MCP server for live account data. Supports accounts in Honeybadger's US region (app.honeybadger.io).
